response.sql: WITH filtered_records AS (SELECT ID, HGB, APPT, PT FROM Laboratory WHERE UA IS NOT NULL AND UA > 3.9), patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) as avg_hgb, AVG(APPT - PT) as avg_appt_minus_pt FROM filtered_records GROUP BY ID) SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) as overall_avg_hgb, AVG(avg_appt_minus_pt) as overall_avg_appt_minus_pt FROM patient_averages

assumptions.assumption: The UA cutoff of 3.9 means UA > 3.9 (records strictly above the threshold), not UA >= 3.9

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff of 3.9 could be inclusive, selecting UA >= 3.9 instead of UA > 3.9
